summary: The diff modifies backend/main.mo and frontend/src/pages/CrossModelSearchPage.tsx to implement deal scoring and sorting. The frontend implementation (REQ-142) appears largely complete with proper badge colors, normalization of missing scores to 'Fair', and tier grouping. The backend file (backend/main.mo) is truncated in the diff, making it impossible to verify the full getCrossModelSearch implementation for REQ-141.

The visible portion only shows imports, type definitions, and the getDepreciationCurve/getCallerUserProfile functions. There is no evidence in the diff that the deal score computation logic (average price per make/model, 10% thresholds, tier sorting) is implemented in getCrossModelSearch.

hallucinated_features.description: ResultCard applies a green border/background highlight (border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5) to 'Good Deal' cards and a red border (border-red-500/20) to 'Overpriced' cards beyond just the badge.
